text:
Situation: Cisplatin has been on FDA's shortage list since 2023-02-10 and as of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on FDA's list for 44 months. Corvale East holds 50 vials of cisplatin 50 mg/50 mL at 3.1 vials per day (16.1 days on hand) and 116 vials of cisplatin 1 mg/mL at 6.2 vials per day (18.7 days on hand). Corvale General holds 94 vials of cisplatin 50 mg/50 mL at 3 vials per day (30.9 days on hand) and 176 vials of cisplatin 1 mg/mL at 5.7 vials per day (31 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1207607 at Thymoorgan Pharmazie Gmbh ended 2022-10-06 and was classified VAI, 127 days before FDA posted the shortage on 2023-02-10. A later FDA inspection 1203954 at the same plant ended 2023-04-25 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2023-07-10, 74 days after the shortage posting. The product label for Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (NDC 00143950401) names THYMOORGAN GMBH PHARMAZIE as a registered plant for manufacture, analysis, labeling, and packing, last inspected VAI 2023-04-25.

Our position: Current inventory covers 16 to 31 days depending on site and presentation. The best available supply option is Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose plant was last inspected VAI 2023-08-24.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Sagent Pharmaceuticals and WG Critical Care, LLC as secondary sources; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report status changes to P&T Committee; requires P&T Committee acknowledgment.

Not recommended: Purchasing from Accord Healthcare Inc. (plant last inspected OAI 2022-12-02) or Apotex Corp. (no verifiable plant on label) at this time.
